rationale.baseline: Trivial baselines that predict majority class or average/random values without learning.
rationale.convolutional: Convolutional neural network architectures including audio/video CNN-based encoders.
rationale.graph_neural_network: Graph-based neural network models (GCN, GAT, graph convolutional variants).
rationale.linear_model: Linear statistical models including logistic, linear, ridge and lasso regression variants.
rationale.llm: Generative large language models used via prompting or fine-tuning.
rationale.other: Techniques, loss functions, feature-selection/dimensionality-reduction methods, data augmentation, and other non-model components or unclear items.
rationale.other_classical_ml: Classical machine learning algorithms that are not trees, SVM, or linear regression.
rationale.other_neural: MLP and other miscellaneous neural network architectures/components not fitting the specific transformer/RNN/CNN/GNN families.
rationale.prediction_setup: Prediction setups describing whether traits are predicted jointly (multi-output) or separately (per-trait), naming no specific model.
rationale.recurrent: Recurrent neural network architectures (LSTM, GRU, RNN, BiLSTM/BiGRU) including attention variants built atop them.
rationale.transformer_encoder: Pretrained transformer encoder models (BERT, RoBERTa, XLNet, ALBERT, DeBERTa, Longformer, sentence embedding encoders) fine-tuned or used as feature extractors.
